'''Fixer's landspeeder''' was a Landspeeder used by [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze "Fixer" Loneozner]] on Tatooine. The speeder could often be seen parked outside [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. It was there in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] when [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] visited [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and other friends shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Inside" />
